judge claude-haiku-4-5 (PASS,PASS): --- vote 1: PASS ---
Looking at the two required findings in the report:

**Question 1: Unguarded concurrent dict access under 🐛 Bugs?**

In the Bugs section, I find:
```
`internal/services/device_service.py:194,383-385,458-460` | R10 Q3: `self.last_seen[device_id] = ...` 
(line 194, inside a per-HTTP-request-thread call path...) and two more iterate-and-delete sites on the same dict 
(`purge()` at 383-385, `_flush_loop` at 458-460) all run outside the `self.mu` lock
```

This is correctly filed under 🐛 Bugs and describes exactly the data race on the `last_seen` dict (written from request thread, iterated from flush thread, no lock). ✓

**Question 2: Production `time.sleep` calls under 🔴 Design Debt (not Bugs)?**

Under 🔴 Design Debt, R10 includes:
```
`internal/services/retry.py:43,57`, `device_service.py:164`, `sync_service.py:99` | Q5: four bare `time.sleep(...)` 
backoff/retry loops on cancellable paths (per-request-reachable), with no cancellation mechanism anywhere
```

This covers the retry backoff (including at `device_service.py:164` in `process_heartbeat` per the cluster description: "bare `time.sleep(attempt * 0.2)` on the DOWN-notification retry loop at :164") and polling sleeps, all filed under Design Debt. The flush-loop sleep mentioned in Bugs is a separate issue (about thread joinability), not the retry backoff specified in the criteria. ✓

Both questions are answered affirmatively.

VERDICT: PASS
